name: HTGR Event-Sequence Dynamic PRA Model
desc: State-diagram model of the helium-cooled reactor mitigation systems and accident scenarios for the Event Sequence Analysis example. Component diagrams model each safety function as Operating/Failed with a per-demand failure event; scenario diagrams (one per initiating-event x plant-operating-state) start at the initiator with its initial decay-heat state, progress through the challenged functions, and end in key states (safe, RC-1, RC-2, RC-3) that mirror the discrete dynamic event tree. Reference an individual scenario as es-dynamic-model.json#<IE>-<POS>.
